data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract a reliable gross prior-year reserve balance or a quantified prior-year development from the provided scanned pages. The available images are rotated and low-resolution in places; the Balance Sheet line for gross 'Claims outstanding' and the technical reserves movement note that would provide a gross prior-year movement could not be unambiguously located or read.
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned, rotated images prevented reliable OCR of key figures. I could identify the gross premiums written (223,899 GBP 000 = GBP 223.899m) from the segmental/premium tables, but could not confidently locate or read the Balance Sheet line 'Claims outstanding' (gross) for the prior year (2018) nor a clear 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure. Many relevant tables are present but illegible at this resolution/orientation. Therefore opening reserves and prior-year development are left null rather than risking incorrect extraction. If you can provide a higher-resolution or properly oriented PDF (or the specific pages for the Balance Sheet and Technical Reserves movement note), I can extract the requested reserve numbers and populate the rest of the fields.
